steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: enter-room
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const room=st.floorPlan.rooms.find(r=>!r.external)||st.floorPlan.rooms[0]; st.enterRoomEditor(room.id); return room.id; })()

steps.name: ghost-items
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); let n=0; for(const it of st.items){ window.__store.getState().updateItemProps(it.id, {opacity:0.3}); n++; } return n; })()

steps.name: restore-items
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); for(const it of st.items){ window.__store.getState().updateItemProps(it.id, {opacity:1}); } return 'restored'; })()
